analysis_plan.unit: world; both record variants and response arms remain paired
analysis_plan.worlds: The same 24 frozen worlds as the cue study, not fresh independent confirmation data.
analysis_plan.bootstrap: 10000 whole-world resamples; descriptive unadjusted 95% percentile intervals
analysis_plan.format: An identical strict JSON schema in both arms; no prose or extra fields.
analysis_plan.invalid_answers: Retain and stop on any returned schema or technical failure; no resampling or continuation.
analysis_plan.interpretation: This compares a reasoning instruction under constrained output. It does not establish whether hidden reasoning occurred or identify an internal mechanism. Changes from earlier free-output runs also change the response format.
analysis_plan.decision: no scientific pass gate; no outcome-dependent extension

accuracy/direct_minus_cue.weighting: Equal weight per complete world; accuracy first averages its two target-record variants.
accuracy/direct_minus_cue.case_weighting: All compliant paired variants, including those in otherwise incomplete worlds.

accuracy/direct.weighting: Equal weight per complete world; accuracy first averages its two target-record variants.

accuracy/cue.weighting: Equal weight per complete world; accuracy first averages its two target-record variants.

record_sensitivity/direct_minus_cue.weighting: Equal weight per complete world; accuracy first averages its two target-record variants.

record_sensitivity/direct.weighting: Equal weight per complete world; accuracy first averages its two target-record variants.

record_sensitivity/cue.weighting: Equal weight per complete world; accuracy first averages its two target-record variants.

uncertainty: 10,000 whole-world bootstrap resamples, seed 981723; descriptive, unadjusted 95% intervals. The sampling unit is the world, not an API call. These reuse the earlier cue worlds, so this is an exploratory follow-up, not a fresh-data replication. Degenerate intervals do not establish certainty or equivalence. Full-plan unscorable bounds are point-estimate bounds, not confidence intervals.
interpretation: If every output complies, a positive direct-minus-cue effect under this constrained interface would show that a generated written explanation is not necessary for the instruction effect in this interface. A null or uncertain effect does not show that written reasoning caused the earlier harm: the constrained format can change strategy. Neither result identifies hidden reasoning, task selection, or a neural mechanism. Correct answers do not by themselves establish record retrieval. No scientific pass threshold, automatic sample extension, or comparison to an unconstrained visible-explanation arm is applied.
failure_policy: Any returned invalid output is retained and never resampled. It causes a technical/output-manipulation failure even if other answers comply. Compliant-subset estimates and bounds in this JSON are audit diagnostics only when interpretation_allowed is false; do not use them to claim a successful manipulation or cue effect.
